+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { addToCart, checkout, getAnalytics, getCartTotals, getFilterCounts, getPrompts, resetDbForTests } from '../src/db/marketplace'
+
+beforeEach(() => resetDbForTests())
+
+describe('marketplace database calculations', () => {
+  it('ranks featured prompts and exposes source vocabulary', async () => {
+    const prompts = await getPrompts({ sort: 'featured' })
+    expect(prompts.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12)
+    expect(prompts[0].title).toBe('The Socratic Tutor')
+    expect(new Set(prompts.map((p) => p.model))).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['GPT-4o', 'Claude', 'Midjourney', 'Flux']))
+  })
+
+  it('computes filter counts and cart totals in SQL', async () => {
+    const counts = await getFilterCounts()
+    expect(counts.freeCount).toBe(1)
+    const cart = await getCartTotals()
+    expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(21)
+    expect(cart.fees).toBe(1.05)
+    expect(cart.total).toBe(22.05)
+  })
+
+  it('computes creator and category analytics', async () => {
+    const analytics = await getAnalytics()
+    expect(analytics.averageOrderValue).toBeGreaterThan(30)
+    expect(analytics.creatorRevenue[0].creatorRevenue).toBeGreaterThan(20)
+    expect(analytics.categoryRevenue.some((row) => row.category === 'Image')).toBe(true)
+    expect(analytics.dailySales).toHaveLength(6)
+  })
+
+  it('moves cart into an order during checkout', async () => {
+    await addToCart(207)
+    const result = await checkout()
+    expect(result.ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.orderId).toBe(7)
+    expect(result.cart.count).toBe(0)
+  })
+})
*** End Patch

+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { addToCart, checkout, getAnalytics, getCartTotals, getPrompt, getPrompts, resetDbForTests, setFavorite } from '../src/db/marketplace'
+
+beforeEach(() => resetDbForTests())
+
+describe('backend behavior contract', () => {
+  it('filters catalog by model, category, search, and favorites', async () => {
+    expect((await getPrompts({ model: 'Claude' })).every((p) => p.model === 'Claude')).toBe(true)
+    expect((await getPrompts({ category: 'Photography' })).every((p) => p.category === 'Photography')).toBe(true)
+    expect((await getPrompts({ search: 'cold email' }))[0].title).toBe('The Cold-Email Closer')
+    expect((await getPrompts({ favoritesOnly: true })).every((p) => p.isFavorite)).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('persists favorite and cart mutations across query calls', async () => {
+    await setFavorite(142, true)
+    expect((await getPrompt(142))?.isFavorite).toBe(true)
+    await addToCart(142)
+    const cart = await getCartTotals()
+    expect(cart.items.find((item) => item.id === 142)?.quantity).toBe(2)
+  })
+
+  it('supports checkout and analytics after mutation', async () => {
+    await addToCart(207)
+    await checkout()
+    const analytics = await getAnalytics()
+    expect(analytics.dailySales.at(-1)?.day).toBe('2026-07-08')
+  })
+})
*** End Patch

+import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'
+
+test('storefront filters, favorites, cart, and analytics smoke flow', async ({ page }) => {
+  await page.goto('/')
+  await expect(page.getByText('POWERPROMPT').first()).toBeVisible()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /GPT-4o/i })).toBeVisible()
+  await expect(page.getByTestId('prompt-card').first()).toBeVisible()
+
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Claude/i }).click()
+  await expect(page.getByText('Senior Code Reviewer')).toBeVisible()
+
+  await page.getByLabel('Search prompts').fill('cold email')
+  await expect(page.getByText('The Cold-Email Closer')).toBeVisible()
+
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Add/i }).first().click()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Added')
+
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: /Cart/i }).first().click()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Cart' })).toBeVisible()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Checkout simulation/i }).click()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Checkout complete')
+
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: /Creator analytics/i }).click()
+  await expect(page.getByText('Average order value')).toBeVisible()
+})
+
+test('mobile dock is available', async ({ page }) => {
+  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 })
+  await page.goto('/')
+  await expect(page.locator('.dock')).toBeVisible()
+  await expect(page.getByLabel('Search prompts')).toBeVisible()
+})
*** End Patch
